The '''VL-25 XT Plasma Core Rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The VL-25 XT Plasma Core Rifle was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Core Worlds and Deep Core Explorer Packs, which were released together on [[May 4]], [[2015]].
